title: Many vendors — no owner of the savings outcome
subtitle: Each provider solves a part; the customer must connect the pieces
a11yLabel: The fragmented market: equipment vendors, software and data providers, auditors and advisors, and financiers — none owning the complete savings outcome.

cards.heading: Equipment vendors
bullets: Solar EPCs sized to the roof, not the load
Meter vendors selling hardware, not answers

cards.heading: Software & data
bullets: Dashboards that show data, not decisions
Monitoring tools disconnected from the bill
Reports that end where implementation begins

cards.heading: Auditors & advisors
bullets: Audit reports without an owner for follow-through
Recommendations that stop at the report

cards.heading: Financiers
bullets: No one accountable for the final outcome

content.note: The customer's unanswered question: what actually reduced my bill — and by how much?
